title: BuildActiv S1
description: A modpack Greatly Inspired by the ModActiv S2 modpack made to improve building in your creative world
body:
The BuildActiv Season 1 Modpack is a building modpack based on the Modactiv Season 2 modpack, it includes most of the Modactiv Season 2 mods as well as some QoL building mods.

Here are some ingame screenshots of the modpack :))

Sidenote : Feel free to join the discord if there is any issues with the Modpack (Rendering Issues, Crashes, Error Messages, Game Not Launching, Specific mods crashing the game...) It helps us greatly improve the work we do and provide the best for you all !
